findings.title: stream_close() may close write buffer while front entry is still sending
findings.claim: The drain wait relies on queue_drained (the done future of the last queued entry), but stop_send_loop() can set that future to an exception immediately while the front entry is still inside send_entry(); then_wrapped ignores the failure and calls write_buf.close() concurrently with the in-flight write/flush.

findings.title: stream_close() is not idempotent
findings.claim: _stream_closing is set but never checked before the !error() branch, so a second concurrent call to stream_close() re-enters the branch, overwriting _sink_closed_future and closing the write buffer a second time; the new drain wait widens this pre-existing window.

findings.title: test_stream_send_after_stream_close doesn't verify send fails or cover new drain logic
findings.claim: The test swallows the result of stream_send_empty_frame() in a catch, so it never asserts the call fails with closed_error, and it doesn't test queuing a frame right before stream_close() to confirm it flushes before close, nor the exceptional queue-future error path from the first finding.

findings.title: Test relies on brittle assumption that client_factory.hooks.back() is the stream…
findings.claim: The test assumes client_factory.hooks.back() belongs to the stream connection and only checks that there are exactly 2 hooks, which is a fragile way to select the right hook.

findings.title: Unexplained compress() override substituting empty temporary_buffer for zero-size data
findings.claim: The compress() override substitutes an empty temporary_buffer when data.size is 0, which looks like a workaround for the lz4 delegate but is not explained.

findings.title: PR description links internal Jira tickets in a public repository
findings.claim: The PR description links internal Jira tickets (CUSTOMER-666, CUSTOMER-678, SCYLLADB-4034) in a public repository.

findings.title: PR description ends with a 'Generated with Claude Code' trailer
findings.claim: The PR description ends with a 'Generated with Claude Code' line, which the user's global instructions forbid.

findings.title: Docs changes checked against close_sink/close_source and sink_impl::close, found…
findings.claim: The docs changes in doc/rpc-streaming.md and include/seastar/rpc/rpc_types.hh were checked against close_sink/close_source and sink_impl::close and found to be consistent with the code.
